page.overview:
What is Gauntlets?

Not to be confused with Powered Gauntlets.

They reappear in Mortal Kombat 11 in the game's Krypt as Kollector trade items. They would also later reappear in Darrius's cameo alongside Hotaru. In Mortal Kombat 1, Darrius lacks his gauntlets, but Havik wields a bladed gauntlet on his left arm.
